operation.body:
### Goal

Implement feedback browsing (FR-002): users can view a list of submitted feedback items with the fields required for triage.

### Acceptance criteria

- An index (or equivalent inbox) lists all feedback items, newest first with a deterministic tie-break when creation times match.
- Each listed item shows title, description, category, and creation time (human-readable is fine).
- User-entered text is escaped on render.
- Controls remain labelled and keyboard-accessible where this goal adds UI.
- Automated tests cover ordering (including tied timestamps) and that listed items expose the required fields at an appropriate boundary (model and/or request/system).
- Pull request contains exact `Closes #<this-issue-number>` and stays within this goal scope.

### Constraints

- Ruby on Rails, SQLite, server-rendered HTML; MIT license; no authentication.
- Build on FR-001 submission flow already on `main` (goal #9, PR #10); do not regress create/validation behaviour.
- Do not edit `docs/security-review.md` or implement goal #3 work.
- Report only checks that actually ran.

### Out of scope

- Category assignment or change UI (FR-003), category filters (FR-004), restart persistence demo (FR-005), invalid-category API handling beyond listing (FR-006), full FR-007/FR-008 delivery, sample dataset, and demo recording.

### Relevant context

FR-001 merged on `main` at `4953b61` (goal #9, PR #10). `Feedback` model includes `category` defaulting to `other`. Parent project #2 targets FR-001–FR-008 overall.
